name: model_op_group_mm
description: Grouped matrix multiply over a row-partitioned A (FlagGems src/flag_gems/ops/group_gemm.py::group_mm). A [M, K] float16/bfloat16/float32, B [num_groups, K, N] same dtype, offs [num_groups] int32 holding the exclusive cumulative end row of each group: group i covers A rows offs[i-1] (or 0 for i=0) up to offs[i] and multiplies them by B[i]. Returns C [M, N] with A's dtype, accumulated in float32 without tf32 and cast once at the end. Rows beyond offs[-1] are left uninitialized by the kernel, so offs[-1] must equal M. Returns a new tensor; the inputs are not modified.
